heading: Frequently Asked <highlight>Questions</highlight>
subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers. Here are the most common questions we get from our travelers.

items.question: Are flight tickets included in the package?
items.answer: No, flight tickets are not included. All our packages cover land arrangements only: hotel, transportation, meals as listed, entrance fees, and your private driver-guide.

items.question: Can I customize the itinerary?
items.answer: Absolutely! Since this is a private tour, the itinerary is highly flexible. You can swap destinations or adjust timings as long as they are within the same geographical route. Just let us know your preferences.

items.question: What kind of hotels do you use?
items.answer: We partner with 4-star properties to ensure a comfortable stay. Depending on your package length, you will stay at Bhanuswari Resort & Spa (Ubud area) for central tours, and Jimbaran Bay Beach Resort (South Bali) for southern tours. This strategic routing minimizes time spent in traffic. If you prefer a different hotel, we can customize the package for you.

items.question: Is the tour private or joined with others?
items.answer: 100% private. You will only be traveling with your own group. You will have a dedicated car and an English-speaking driver-guide who will assist you throughout the trip.

items.question: How do we make the payment?
items.answer: We require a 30% deposit to secure your hotel and tour booking. The remaining balance can be paid in cash (IDR, USD, or EUR) upon arrival in Bali.
